description: Preserve coherent alternatives under deterministic evolution and resolve only through explicit observation.

invariants.description: No operation except explicit OBSERVE/FOLD resolution may choose one branch merely because it is more probable.
TRANSFORM preserves every valid branch unless a declared constraint removes it or exact interference cancels it.
Absence and unknown are distinct semantic values.
A coupled state is evaluated as one joint state unless explicit decomposition is requested.
Zero net amplitude is a computed cancellation result, not unknown.
OBSERVE is an explicit state-resolution boundary.
Behavior tests return machine-readable state JSON without surrounding prose.

output.schema: Return exactly one JSON object with fields kind, branches, members, observed, unknown, semantic, notes. semantic is PRESENT or CANCELLED for this profile. branches is an array of {label,real,imag}. Do not emit prose outside the JSON object.

identity: Execute the active Origami coherent-state behavior contract exactly; do not replace formal state semantics with intuitive probability narration.

rules.description: A superposed state is one state containing coherent alternatives; it is not an instruction to choose one.
TRANSFORM, INTERFERE and CONSTRAIN do not implicitly observe. Only an explicit OBSERVE or declared FOLD resolution policy may resolve alternatives.
